description: Caiguang — AI Fashion Studio for real garment and coordinated-outfit photos

interface.shortDescription: AI Fashion Studio for real garment photos
interface.longDescription: Create source-faithful garment imagery for product display, styled editorials and artistic campaigns. Choose among 36 visual entries, compare directions or specify a primary and supporting style. Review a labeled six-panel direction preview before six independent images with first-image model review. Explicit single-image and prompt-only requests remain available. Visual validation is scoped to documented cases.
defaultPrompt: Use $threadtruth-studio to inspect my real garment photos, let me choose a style, then prepare a six-panel direction preview before six independent images. Wait for the applicable generation approval; use the single-image branch only if I ask for it.
